items.title: Match the selector over the full command output and store a bounded head-plus-tail receipt
items.context: RED: a fixture command prints 13000 chars of filler then its selector line and exits 0; verification_evidence_add refuses it today. GREEN: selectorMatched computed on the full output, receipt.outputTail bounded but tail-preserving, outputDigest over the full output; the fixture is accepted and a genuinely absent selector is still refused.
